写工具，也写字I build tools, and I write

七个开源工具，外加四篇文章：一个 Flutter 的 Markdown 编辑器、一层 Agent 运行时、本地 Ollama 编码助手、OCR 的 MCP 服务、Windows 上的 JDK 切换器，还有这个站本身。Seven open-source tools and four essays — a Flutter Markdown editor, an agent runtime, a local Ollama coding harness, an OCR MCP server, a Windows JDK switcher, and this site.

作品Projects

MdeditorMdeditor

Flutter 壳、Milkdown 芯的 Android Markdown 编辑器A Flutter shell around a Milkdown core, on Android

Milkdown 内核跑在 WebView 里，Flutter 只做壳，写起来是所见即所得；代码块自带高亮、行号、折叠与复制，文档能直接导出 DOCX、HTML 与 PDF。文件走 Android SAF，打开—编辑—保存始终是同一个文档 URI，每个版本由 GitHub Actions 自动打包发布。A Milkdown core inside a WebView, a Flutter shell around it — editing feels WYSIWYG. Code blocks ship with highlighting, line numbers, folding and copy, and documents export to DOCX, HTML and PDF. Files flow through Android SAF so open–edit–save keeps the same document URI, and every release is packaged automatically by GitHub Actions.

Intent OSIntent OS

把意图编译成可验证、可回滚的执行链Compiling intent into verifiable, rollback-safe chains

它不是一个 agent，也不是另一个 agent 框架。它是一层运行在 LLM 之上的 runtime：意图先被编译成带验收标准的 Plan DAG，副作用必须经过按风险分级的审批闸门，每一次回执都写进哈希链审计日志。换掉底下的 agent，这一层不变。Not an agent, and not another agent framework — a runtime layer above the LLM. Intent compiles into a Plan DAG with acceptance criteria, side effects pass a risk-tiered approval gate, and every receipt lands in a hash-chained audit log. Swap the agent underneath; this layer stays.

Local Ollama HarnessLocal Ollama Harness

终端里的本地代码助手A local coding assistant in your terminal

用一句自然语言在终端里创建、查看、修改并运行 Python 文件，全程只连本机 Ollama，默认 qwen2.5-coder:3b。所有文件读写与执行都限制在 sandbox/ 目录内，越界路径直接拒绝。Create, read, edit and run Python files from a plain-language prompt. Everything talks to local Ollama only (qwen2.5-coder:3b by default), and file access is confined to sandbox/.

MiniMax LockdownMiniMax Lockdown

只锁一个不太可信的模型A cage for one untrusted model

一个 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook：当前模型是 MiniMax 时启用硬拒绝、下载前询问、灰区 LLM 审计；换成别的模型直接 exit 0，零开销。A Claude Code PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook: hard-deny, ask before download, and an LLM auditor for the gray zone — but only when the active model is MiniMax. Any other model exits 0 at once.

OCR MCPOCR MCP

给 agent 用的 OCR 工具服务OCR as an MCP service for agents

基于 PaddleOCR 的 MCP stdio server：文字、表格、手写、公式都能认，公式直接输出 LaTeX；输入支持本地路径和 HTTP(S) URL，pip install 之后就能接进 Claude Desktop。A PaddleOCR-backed MCP stdio server: text, tables, handwriting and formulas — with LaTeX output. Inputs can be local paths or HTTP(S) URLs, and one pip install plugs it into Claude Desktop.

JEnv for WindowsJEnv for Windows

用纯批处理按名字切换 JDKSwitching JDKs by name, in pure batch

一个 java.bat 垫片拦截 PATH 上的 java，把它转发到你选中的 JDK。同一个终端里，两个项目可以跑在两套 JDK 上；JAVA_HOME 永远指向 JEnv 目录，jenv use / jenv local 立刻对读环境变量的工具生效。A java.bat shim intercepts java on PATH and forwards it to the JDK you picked — two projects, two JDKs, one terminal. JAVA_HOME always points at the JEnv directory, so jenv use / jenv local take effect immediately for tools that read it.

linuxlinking.github.iolinuxlinking.github.io

你正在看的这个站The site you are looking at

零依赖的手写静态站：暗底海报的首页、图纸式第二视图、中英切换，全部由原生 HTML/CSS/ES module 完成，没有一个外部库。源码由一个零依赖的 Python 脚本组装，产物仍是可直接发布的静态文件。A hand-written static site with no dependencies: an ink-poster home page, a schematic second view and zh/en switching, all in native HTML, CSS and ES modules. The sources are assembled by a dependency-free Python script; the output is still plain static files you can publish as-is.

文字Writing

小模型不可信，守卫必须是代码Distrust the Model, Encode the Guard

本地 3B 模型写代码，问题不是笨，是不可靠。Local Ollama Harness 把每一种失败模式都变成了守卫里的一条确定性规则：模型只负责提议，裁决权在 harness。A local 3B model isn't dumb — it's unreliable. Local Ollama Harness turns every known failure mode into a deterministic guard rule: the model proposes, the harness disposes.

为什么我不做 Agent，而做一层 RuntimeWhy a Runtime, Not Another Agent Framework

每个 agent 框架最终都会撞上同一堵墙。Intent OS 的回答是：不做第八十个框架，做框架之上的那层确定性——意图编译成带验收标准的计划，副作用过审批闸门，回执进哈希链。Every agent harness hits the same wall. Intent OS answers by not being the 80th framework: compile intent into plans with acceptance criteria, gate side effects, and hash-chain the receipts.

把 Milkdown 塞进 WebView：混血编辑器的取舍Milkdown in a WebView: Trade-offs of a Hybrid Editor

Flutter 做壳，WebView 里跑 Milkdown，中间靠一个 JS 桥说话——这不是偷懒，是明确的取舍。单一桥协议、SAF URI 持久化、手写 OOXML、主题单向流，四个决定及其代价。A Flutter shell, Milkdown in a WebView, one JS bridge between them — a deliberate trade, not a shortcut. One bridge protocol, persisted SAF URIs, hand-rolled OOXML, one-way theming.

给一个不太可信的模型造笼子A Cage for One Untrusted Model

代码管必然，人管例外，模型管灰区——三层防线锁住 Claude Code 里那个不太靠谱的模型，而且只锁它一个：换任何别的模型，这套笼子零开销。Code handles the certain, humans handle the exceptions, a model handles the gray zone — three layers lock down one untrusted model in Claude Code, and only that one: any other model runs at zero cost.
